adaptations: The PDF includes iOS and Android variants. iOS grouped geometry is the default for the web client.
No simulated OS status bar, native keyboard or home indicator is drawn. Real browser safe areas are respected.
Persian type, four existing product destinations, roles, contracts and Makan identity are retained.
No individual workspace profile, presence, bio or hidden phone number is invented.
The PDF contains no Makan educational screens or full desktop specification; these share the same tokens and responsive conventions.
Existing backend gaps for conversation photos, whole-conversation reactions, live calls and other disabled settings remain explicit.
Assistant results remain a labeled local preview until its backend contract is implemented.
